summary: The reel depicts a beach scene with characters drinking mate and carrying beach gear. The flat 2D style is consistently applied, though some shots suffer from minor repetitive staging and text placement.

clean: Shot 0: character correctly holding thermos and beach mat
Shot 4: close-up on thermos correctly highlights the object
Shot 7: character pouring hot water into the gourd correctly
Shot 10: two characters sharing a mate round correctly
unclean: Shot 2: suegra expression and pose are repeated almost identically across frames
Shot 9: wind blowing yerba could be more explicitly visualized beyond text labels

clean: Consistent flat 2D vector style throughout all frames
Clear color contrast and appropriate prop scaling (thermos, mate gourd, beach elements)
Readable top captions and headline pills
unclean: Shot 2: dark background pill slightly overlaps the character's head top edge
